ui_scenarios.name: WASD movement feel is acceptable
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires player judgment about speed, acceleration, and spatial feel.

ui_scenarios.name: Mouse-look feel is acceptable
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires player judgment about sensitivity and comfort.

ui_scenarios.name: Escape releases mouse capture and click recaptures it
ui_scenarios.reason: Current automated input checks do not exercise OS-level mouse capture reliably.

ui_scenarios.name: Prompt readability is acceptable in the actual window
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual judgment beyond nonblank screenshot checks.

ui_scenarios.name: Receiving box, display rack, register, and used-game placement makes sense
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human composition review while graybox layout is changing.

ui_scenarios.name: Held item stays visible without blocking normal navigation
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment while moving and looking around the actual window.

ui_scenarios.name: Stocked game is visibly upright and intentional in the rack
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual judgment from several player angles.

ui_scenarios.name: Display rack reads as a used-game rack after category assignment changes
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment that metadata changes did not make stocking behavior or visual intent confusing.

ui_scenarios.name: Pricing panel text and controls are readable in the actual window
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about UI readability and control clarity.

ui_scenarios.name: Apply-to-matching pricing option is readable and understandable
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about whether the batch-pricing option is clear in the actual window.

ui_scenarios.name: Pricing panel closes back into first-person mouse capture cleanly
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires OS/window-level input judgment beyond current automated checks.

ui_scenarios.name: Screenshot composition is useful, not merely nonblank
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual judgment; automated gate only checks dimensions and nonblank pixels.

ui_scenarios.name: Buyers visibly wait at the register after stocking Star Trader copies
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about queue placement and readability in the actual window.

ui_scenarios.name: Multiple queued buyers have readable spacing and do not overlap the register
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual judgment about queue composition and customer placement.

ui_scenarios.name: Buyers visibly walk from browsing to rack to register without clipping badly
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual judgment about movement readability and clipping while the graybox layout is changing.

ui_scenarios.name: Customer spawn, approach, and queue positions read naturally in the current layout
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about customer path composition beyond bounded automated path checks.

ui_scenarios.name: Register sale completion message is readable in the actual window
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about prompt/message readability during checkout.

ui_scenarios.name: Trade-in seller and carried game are readable at the register
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual judgment about seller placement and carried-item readability.

ui_scenarios.name: Trade-in register prompt and completion message are readable
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about prompt/message readability during the trade-in.

ui_scenarios.name: Trade-in offer panel condition, demand, market, and accept/decline controls are readable
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about panel readability and whether the offer review is understandable.

ui_scenarios.name: Backroom computer placement is readable and does not look like a second register
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual judgment about prop placement and terminal identity.

ui_scenarios.name: Day summary panel text and controls are readable in the actual window
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about summary readability and mouse capture behavior.

ui_scenarios.name: Backroom category demand readout is readable and does not crowd the panel
ui_scenarios.reason: Automated tests verify the demand text exists; the player must judge whether the expanded backroom panel is visually comfortable.

ui_scenarios.name: Backroom market drift readout is readable and understandable
ui_scenarios.reason: Automated tests verify market drift text exists; the player must judge whether current and drifted market values are readable.

ui_scenarios.name: Backroom summary numbers match completed single and multiple sales
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human confirmation after playing through single-sale and multi-sale loops.

ui_scenarios.name: Closed-day report is readable and matches the played day
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human confirmation after playing through a complete day and closing it.

ui_scenarios.name: Backroom inventory summary is readable and matches visible active inventory
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human comparison between the summary panel and visible stocked/receiving items.

ui_scenarios.name: Sold item is no longer visually available on the rack after checkout
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human visual confirmation from normal player angles.

ui_scenarios.name: Fixture ghost valid and invalid states are visually readable
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about whether translucent green and red placement previews are clear in the actual window.

ui_scenarios.name: Fixture rotate and snap controls feel predictable
ui_scenarios.reason: Requires human judgment about whether fixed-step rotation and grid movement feel understandable before final placement UI exists.

ui_scenarios.name: Suspicious event flags do not visibly interrupt normal store progression
ui_scenarios.reason: The hidden-thread event log is intentionally infrastructure-only for now; human playtest should confirm no new visible story UI appeared.
